description: project-sessions: SessionStart creates or resumes this repo's project session, detached, and names it in one line (auto mode: attended sessions or PROJECT_SESSIONS_AUTO=1); UserPromptSubmit adds one line per prompt and creates it in the caller's mode if missing; PreToolUse (Bash) adds the caller's permission mode to a `project-session ensure` call that names none. All silent outside git and inside background sessions, and fail open.
